tools.name: find_business

tools.name: site_get
tools.description: Get this site's business overview and public contact details.

tools.name: search_site_pages
tools.description: Find published pages. Cite the returned title and URL.

tools.name: read_site_page
tools.description: Read a published page by its search result id.

tools.description: List published business locations, hours, and contact methods.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether a city or postal code is explicitly served. Include the region when known.

tools.name: get_offerings
tools.description: Browse published general offerings and public prices.

tools.name: get_public_resources
tools.description: Find public guides, brochures, and policy links.

tools.name: list_public_forms
tools.description: List owner-selected public forms and links.

tools.name: get_public_form

tools.name: prepare_form_submission
tools.description: Prepare a selected form for the visitor to review. Collect contact information in the form.

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Send the visitor-reviewed form after permission and verification.

tools.name: service_search
tools.description: Find published service offerings.

tools.name: service_get
tools.description: Get the description of an eligible service.

tools.name: service_windows
tools.description: Find provisional service windows. Staff must confirm.

tools.name: service_estimate
tools.description: Estimate a selected service from an explicit quantity. Staff must confirm.

tools.name: service_request_prepare

tools.name: service_request_submit

tools.description: Read an eligible rental item, its pictures, contents, and setup requirements.

tools.name: add_rental_quote_item

tools.name: update_rental_quote_item

tools.description: Remove a variant from the rental cart.

tools.name: rental_availability

tools.name: rental_estimate

tools.name: review_rental_quote

tools.name: submit_rental_quote
tools.description: Send the exact reviewed request into Leads. No reservation is made.

tools.name: public_request_review
tools.description: Validate customer input and show the exact request for confirmation.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site_pages, review_rental_quote · Private data: site_get, get_locations, prepare_form_submission, update_rental_quote_details · Public sink: submit_form, service_request_submit, submit_rental_quote · Destructive: remove_rental_quote_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site_pages, review_rental_quote · Private data: site_get, get_locations, prepare_form_submission, update_rental_quote_details · Public sink: submit_form, service_request_submit, submit_rental_quote · Destructive: remove_rental_quote_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
